metaTitle: Inflatable Air Tents: Pros and Cons
description: How air beam tents work, their wind and setup advantages, and the weight, puncture and pressure issues to weigh before you buy one.
directAnswer: An inflatable tent swaps poles for air beams you pump up in minutes, which suits campground families and windy sites. The trade-offs are higher cost, more weight and the need for a pump, a gauge and a patch kit.
